info.description: Standalone multi-tenant Identity Provider — email/password auth, JWT, refresh tokens, TOTP 2FA, SAML 2.0, RBAC, Admin UI, and AI/Agent security.
info.title: EMC Auth Server

get.description: Returns all active agent registrations for the requesting tenant. Requires admin:access.

post.description: Creates an agent registration and returns the raw API key once. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns risk-scored analysis for all active agents in the tenant. Requires admin:access.

post.description: Validates an agent API key and returns a signed short-lived JWT. Public — no prior auth required.
post.summary: Authenticate an agent and issue a JWT

delete.description: Revokes an agent registration belonging to the requesting tenant. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns all active API keys for the caller's tenant. The raw key is never included.

post.description: Creates a new API key for machine-to-machine auth. The raw key is returned exactly once.

delete.description: Permanently revokes an API key. The key is immediately invalid.

get.description: Returns all per-app rate limit configs for the tenant. Requires apps:read.
Returns a paginated, filtered list of the tenant's applications. Secrets are never included.

post.description: Registers a new application for the tenant. Returns client_id and client_secret — secret is shown exactly once and can never be retrieved again (only rotated).

get.description: Returns provider configs without secrets. Requires apps:read.
get.summary: List social login providers configured for an application

put.description: Creates or updates the provider credentials (client secret stored AES-256-GCM encrypted) and the exact-match redirect allow-list. Requires apps:write.
put.summary: Configure a social login provider for an application

delete.description: Deletes the provider config. Existing linked identities and sessions are unaffected; new logins via this provider stop immediately. Requires apps:write.
delete.summary: Remove a social login provider from an application

get.description: Returns the application's MFA mode (disabled|optional|required; no explicit policy = optional) plus enrollment stats over the application's own user base.

put.description: Sets the application's MFA mode and (optionally) its allowed methods. 'required' forces enrollment in an allowed method at the next login of every not-yet-enrolled user; 'disabled' rejects new enrollments (already-active enrollments still gate login until an admin resets them); 'optional' restores the default opt-in behaviour. allowed_methods omitted keeps the current set (default ["totp"]).

parameters.description: MFA mode (disabled | optional | required) + optional allowed_methods subset of [totp, email]
parameters.name: body

get.description: Returns the custom per-minute limit for the application. Requires apps:read.

put.description: Creates or updates the per-minute request limit for the application. Requires apps:write.

delete.description: Removes the custom rate limit; the app falls back to the default. Requires apps:write.

get.description: Returns all roles scoped to the given application with their permission lists. Requires admin:access.

post.description: Creates a role scoped to one of the caller's applications, with optional permission assignments. Requires admin:access.
post.summary: Create an end-user role inside an application

put.description: Renames an end-user role inside the application. System roles cannot be renamed. Requires admin:access.
Marks the role as the one auto-assigned to users who self-register through this application, clearing any previous default. Requires admin:access.
put.summary: Mark a role as the application's default

delete.description: Removes the user's TOTP enrollment (support path for lost phone + backup codes). The user must belong to the application's own user base. If the application's MFA mode is 'required', the user is forced through enrollment again at their next login. Idempotent.

get.description: Returns one application (active or inactive) by ID. The secret is never included.

put.description: Updates an active application's name and/or type. Empty fields are left unchanged.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an application. Its client_id is immediately rejected on login, register, and the client_credentials grant.

post.description: Generates a new client_secret for the application. The old secret stops working immediately. The new secret is returned exactly once — it is stored only as a hash and can never be revealed later.

get.description: Returns paginated audit events scoped to the caller's tenant. Requires admin:access.
Returns paginated audit events across ALL tenants. Requires tenant:manage (super_admin only).

post.description: Authenticates a user that belongs to the authenticated application's own user base — invisible to POST /auth/login and to every other application. Application credentials via Authorization: Basic header only.
post.summary: Login an end user via application credentials

post.description: Emails a single-use, 15-minute sign-in link to the account address if it exists in the application's user base. Always returns success for unknown emails (no account enumeration). Requires magic-link sign-in to be enabled on the application's auth policy.

403.description: Magic link not enabled for this application

post.description: Consumes the single-use token from the emailed link. The application's MFA policy still applies: the response is a token pair, an OTP challenge (requires_otp), or a forced-enrollment challenge (403 mfa_enrollment_required) — exactly like a password login.

401.description: Invalid application credentials or invalid/expired link

post.description: Creates a user account owned by the authenticated application — the same email may hold independent accounts in different applications. Application credentials via Authorization: Basic header only; no tenant slug needed.
post.summary: Register an end user via application credentials

409.description: Email already registered in this application

post.description: Sends a reset link to the email address. ALWAYS returns 200 regardless of whether the email is registered (prevents email enumeration).
Authenticates an existing user by email and password only. The tenant is resolved automatically from which account the password matches — no tenant slug or header is required.

Verifies the first TOTP code for a pending enrollment, marks MFA active, and completes the login in the same step — the response carries the token pair. 5 incorrect codes invalidate the enrollment session.
post.summary: Activate forced MFA enrollment and complete login

401.description: Invalid code or expired enrollment token

post.description: Sends a one-time code to the pending account's inbox for a login against a 'required'-MFA application. Submitting that code to /auth/login/mfa/activate enrolls the user in email MFA and completes the login. Available only when the application's allowed_methods include "email".
post.summary: Begin forced MFA enrollment via email

parameters.description: Enrollment token from the login response
parameters.name: body

403.description: Email method not allowed for this application

post.description: Exchanges the enrollment token returned by a login against a 'required'-MFA application for a TOTP secret (otpauth:// URI + backup codes). The token authorizes only this call and /auth/login/mfa/activate; no JWT is issued until activation completes.

parameters.description: Enrollment token from the login response
parameters.name: body

post.description: Submit the TOTP code (or backup code) to complete a two-step login. The session allows 5 incorrect codes before it is invalidated. Returns the full token pair (and sets auth cookies for browser clients).
Re-sends the one-time email code for an open OTP challenge (max 3 re-sends per challenge). Only available when the challenge's methods include "email".
Revokes the supplied refresh token. Idempotent — calling twice is safe.
Authenticates an API key (X-API-Key or Authorization: ApiKey) and returns a short-lived management JWT valid for 15 minutes. Use the returned token as Bearer auth on admin endpoints.
post.summary: Exchange API key for management JWT

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile decoded from the JWT.
Returns the authenticated user's own recent audit log entries.

post.description: Consumes the single-use login_code issued by the social login callback and returns the standard access + refresh token pair.
post.summary: Exchange social login code for tokens

delete.description: Disables TOTP for the current user. Requires a valid TOTP code or backup code. Rejected when the user's application has MFA mode 'required' — users cannot opt out of a mandated policy.

403.description: MFA is required by the application's policy

post.description: Verifies the first TOTP code and marks the enrollment active.

Replaces all remaining backup codes with a fresh set of 8 WITHOUT rotating the TOTP secret — the authenticator app keeps working. Requires a valid current TOTP or backup code. Every previous backup code is invalidated; the new plaintext codes are shown exactly once.

delete.description: Disables email MFA for the current user. Requires a fresh emailed code (request one via POST /auth/otp/email/send). Rejected when it is the user's last second factor under a 'required' application policy.

403.description: MFA is required by the application's policy

post.description: Verifies the emailed code and marks email MFA active. From then on, logins are challenged with a one-time code sent to the account's inbox.

Starts email-OTP enrollment: sends a verification code to the account's email address. Activate with POST /auth/otp/email/activate. Rejected when the application's MFA mode is 'disabled' or its policy does not allow the email method.

403.description: MFA disabled or email method not allowed for this application

post.description: Sends a fresh one-time code to the account's inbox for an already-active email MFA enrollment — used as proof for self-service actions such as disabling email MFA.
post.summary: Send an email MFA verification code

post.description: Generates a TOTP secret and returns an otpauth:// URI plus backup codes. The authenticator issuer is the owning application's name for application-scoped users. Rejected when the application's MFA mode is 'disabled'. Re-enrolling while active requires a valid current TOTP or backup code in the body.

403.description: MFA disabled for this application, or missing re-enrollment proof

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's TOTP enrollment state and how many single-use backup codes remain — clients should prompt regeneration when the count runs low.

post.description: Issues a new access + refresh token pair and immediately invalidates the old refresh token.
Creates a user account in the specified tenant and returns a token pair.
Validates the reset token, updates the user's password, and revokes all active refresh tokens.
Authenticates the user by email and password only, and stores tokens in HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookies. The tenant is resolved automatically — no tenant slug or header is required.
Revokes the refresh token stored in the cookie and clears both auth cookies.
Rotates the access and refresh tokens using the refresh cookie.
Issues a service-level access token. Credentials via Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:client_secret) header only. No user involved, no refresh token issued.

get.description: Returns the white-label sender configured for the tenant (or one application). The SMTP password is never returned — has_password reports whether one is stored. 404 = no sender at this scope (the global server sender applies).

404.description: No sender configured at this scope

put.description: Creates or updates the white-label sender for the tenant (or one application). MFA code emails then go out From this address via this SMTP relay, with priority application → tenant → global; a relay failure falls back to the global sender. The SMTP password is stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM); omit it on update to keep the current one. The owner is responsible for SPF/DKIM on the sending domain.

delete.description: Removes the white-label sender at this scope; sends fall back to the next level (application → tenant → global).

404.description: No sender configured at this scope

get.description: Returns all permissions for the caller's tenant. Requires admin:access.

post.description: Creates a new permission within the caller's tenant. Requires admin:access.

409.description: Permission name already exists in this tenant

put.description: Renames a permission and/or replaces its description. Empty name keeps the current one. Requires admin:access.

delete.description: Deletes a permission from the caller's tenant. Cascades to roles and users. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns all roles in the caller's tenant with their permission lists. Requires admin:access.

post.description: Creates a role in the caller's tenant with optional permission assignments. Requires admin:access.

delete.description: Deletes a non-system role from the tenant. Users assigned this role will have their role cleared. Requires admin:access.

put.description: Replaces the permission set on a role. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns the SAML IdP configuration for the requesting tenant. Requires admin:access.

put.description: Upserts the SAML IdP configuration for the requesting tenant. Requires admin:access.
put.summary: Create or update tenant SAML configuration

get.description: Returns audit-log-based activity counts scoped to the caller's tenant. Requires admin:access.
Returns audit-log-based activity counts across all tenants. Requires tenant:manage permission.

Returns tenants scoped to the caller's permissions: callers with tenant:manage get a paginated, filtered list of every tenant; any other authenticated caller gets only the tenants tied to their own account email, each with their role and usage stats (search/status/region/pagination params are ignored in that case).

parameters.description: Search by name, display name, or domain
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Filter by status: active | inactive | suspended (suspended maps to inactive)
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Rows per page (default 25, max 100); alias: limit
parameters.name: per_page

post.description: Creates a new isolated tenant and auto-seeds an owner role with 8 default permissions and an owner user using the provided owner_email. The owner.temp_password in the response is shown once and never stored — hand it to the tenant owner. Requires tenant:manage permission (super_admin only).

get.description: Returns whether a tenant slug is available. Always responds 200. Requires tenant:manage permission.

Returns stats scoped to the caller's permissions: callers with tenant:manage get system-wide tenant/application/user counts with month-over-month deltas; any other authenticated caller gets counts aggregated only across the tenants tied to their own account email (no deltas).
Returns a single tenant by ID. Requires tenant:manage permission.

put.description: Updates editable fields on a tenant. Requires tenant:manage permission.

delete.description: Soft-deactivates a tenant (sets is_active=false). Requires tenant:manage permission.

put.description: Sets is_active=true for a previously deactivated tenant. Requires tenant:manage permission.
Replaces the list of allowed CORS origins for a tenant. Pass an empty array to disable CORS enforcement. Requires tenant:manage.

get.description: Returns paginated audit events for the specified tenant. Requires tenant:manage (super_admin only).
get.summary: Activity feed for a target tenant

get.description: Returns all per-app rate limit configs for the tenant. Requires apps:read.
Returns the custom per-minute limit for the application. Requires apps:read.

put.description: Creates or updates the per-minute request limit for the application. Requires apps:write.

delete.description: Removes the custom rate limit; the app falls back to the default. Requires apps:write.

get.description: Returns all roles (with permissions) belonging to the specified tenant. Requires tenant:manage permission.
get.summary: List roles for a target tenant

post.description: Creates a role and optionally assigns permissions to it. Requires tenant:manage permission.
post.summary: Create role in a target tenant

delete.description: Permanently deletes a role from the target tenant. Requires tenant:manage.
delete.summary: Delete a role from a target tenant

put.description: Replaces the full permission set on a role in the target tenant. Requires tenant:manage.
put.summary: Replace permissions on a target-tenant role

get.description: Returns audit-log-based activity counts for the specified tenant. Requires tenant:manage (super_admin only).
get.summary: Activity stats for a target tenant

get.description: Returns a paginated, searchable list of users in the caller's tenant. Requires admin:access.

parameters.description: Search by email, first name, or last name
parameters.name: search

post.description: Creates a user in the caller's tenant with an optional role. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns a user's details. Requires admin:access.

put.description: Updates a user's profile (email, name). Requires admin:access.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a user (is_deleted=true, is_active=false). ID preserved for audit. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns a user's profile plus MFA status, linked identities, active-session count, and last activity. Requires users:read.

post.description: Sends a password reset email to the specified user. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns the external identities (Google etc.) linked to one user in the caller's tenant. Requires users:read.
get.summary: List a user's linked social identities

delete.description: Removes the provider link. Refused when it is the user's only login method (no password and no other identity). Requires users:write.
delete.summary: Unlink a social identity from a user

get.description: Returns the user's enrolled MFA methods and remaining backup codes. Requires users:read.

put.description: Sets the user's role within the tenant. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns the user's active sessions (one per session family) with IP, user agent, and last activity. Requires users:read.

delete.description: Revokes every active session and invalidates issued tokens, signing the user out everywhere. Requires users:write.
delete.summary: Revoke all of a user's sessions

delete.description: Revokes one session family for the user. Requires users:write.

put.description: Sets a user's active status. Blocking (is_active=false) revokes all sessions and invalidates issued tokens. Requires users:write.

get.description: Consumes the single-use state, exchanges the code (PKCE), verifies the provider ID token, resolves/links/provisions the user, and redirects back to the application with a one-time login_code.

parameters.description: Opaque state issued at login start
parameters.name: state

get.description: Validates the application and redirect target, then redirects the browser to the provider's consent screen (Authorization Code + PKCE).

parameters.description: Post-login redirect target (must be in the application's allow-list; optional when the list has exactly one entry)
parameters.name: redirect

post.description: Receives IdP SAMLResponse. Currently returns 501 — disabled until IdP XML signature verification is implemented.

get.description: Redirects the browser to the configured IdP with a signed SAMLRequest.
Returns SAML Service Provider metadata XML for the given tenant. Used by IdPs to configure the SP.

connections.description:
Connections lists how this user can sign in: "password" when a
credentials row exists, plus every linked federated provider (Auth0's
"Connection" column).

last_login_at.description: LastLoginAt is the most recent session activity (Auth0's "Latest Login").

logins_count.description:
LoginsCount is the number of successful logins on record (audit-derived,
Auth0's stats.loginsCount equivalent).

connections.description:
Connections lists how this user can sign in: "password" when a
credentials row exists, plus every linked federated provider (Auth0's
"Connection" column).

last_login_at.description: LastLoginAt is the most recent session activity (Auth0's "Latest Login").

logins_count.description:
LoginsCount is the number of successful logins on record (audit-derived,
Auth0's stats.loginsCount equivalent).

request_count.description: total audit events attributed to this agent

expires_at.description: UTC unix timestamp when access token expires

enrolled_users.description:
Enrollment stats over the application's own isolated user base — for the
owner dashboard. Pending = TOTP enrolled but never activated.

magic_link_enabled.description:
Passwordless magic-link sign-in (opt-in; the redirect URL is the
application frontend that receives ?token=…).

updated_at.description: UpdatedAt is nil when no explicit policy row exists (implicit 'optional').

app_type.description: web | spa | m2m | native; defaults to web
